claim_text: NASA confirmed that Earth will experience 15 days of total darkness in November.
supporting_summary: NASA never issued a warning about 15 days of darkness. The rumor originates from a recurring internet hoax claiming a planetary alignment between Venus and Jupiter will cause darkness.
relevant_passages: NASA confirmed no such event will happen. Planetary alignments do not block sunlight from reaching Earth.|Scientists at NASA and independent astronomers confirmed the claim is a complete hoax that recirculates periodically.
irrelevant_passages: NASA launched the James Webb Space Telescope to observe distant galaxies and early cosmic history.|Solar flares occur periodically during the sun's eleven year solar magnetic activity cycle.

claim_text: Drinking warm lemon water cures cancer and is 10,000 times stronger than chemotherapy.
supporting_summary: There is no scientific or clinical evidence that lemon juice cures cancer or outperforms chemotherapy. While citrus contains antioxidants, it cannot replace medical oncology treatment.
relevant_passages: Medical oncologists and cancer research organizations confirm lemons do not cure cancer or replace chemotherapy.|Clinical trials show that while citrus flavonoids have antioxidant properties, drinking lemon water has no proven therapeutic cancer cure effect in humans.
irrelevant_passages: Chemotherapy uses cytotoxic anti-neoplastic drugs to treat various forms of malignant neoplasms.|Citrus fruits are cultivated widely in tropical and subtropical climates around the world.

claim_text: The Eiffel Tower in Paris was hit by a massive fire and partially destroyed in 2024.
supporting_summary: Viral videos showing the Eiffel Tower engulfed in flames were generated using computer imagery (CGI). Paris fire services and monument operators confirmed no fire occurred.
relevant_passages: Paris police and the Eiffel Tower management company SETE confirmed no fire broke out at the monument.|Reuters verified that the circulating video was created with computer-generated visual effects and was not real footage.
irrelevant_passages: The Eiffel Tower was constructed between 1887 and 1889 as the entrance to the 1889 World's Fair in Paris.|France hosted the 2024 Summer Olympic Games in Paris featuring events across metropolitan venues.

claim_text: WHO declared monkeypox a public health emergency of international concern in August 2024.
supporting_summary: The World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus declared the mpox surge in Africa a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) on August 14, 2024.
relevant_passages: WHO Director-General declared the mpox upsurge in the DRC and other African nations a public health emergency of international concern on August 14 2024.|The declaration followed advice from an independent IHR Emergency Committee regarding the rapid spread of clade Ib mpox.
irrelevant_passages: The World Health Organization was founded on April 7 1948 and is headquartered in Geneva Switzerland.|Smallpox was officially declared eradicated by the World Health Organization in 1980.

claim_text: India's Chandrayaan-3 successfully landed near the lunar south pole in August 2023.
supporting_summary: ISRO's Vikram lander successfully executed a soft touchdown on the lunar surface near the south polar region on August 23, 2023, making India the fourth nation to land on the Moon.
relevant_passages: The Indian Space Research Organisation confirmed Vikram lander made a successful soft landing on the Moon on August 23 2023.|India became the first nation to land near the lunar south polar region and the fourth country to touch down on the lunar surface.
irrelevant_passages: Chandrayaan-1 was launched in October 2008 and successfully detected water molecules on the lunar surface.|The Moon completes one full orbit around Earth approximately every twenty seven days.

claim_text: 5G cellular networks generate radiation that transmits or creates coronavirus infections.
supporting_summary: Viruses cannot travel through radio waves or mobile networks. COVID-19 spread in many countries that had no 5G networks. Electromagnetic radiation is non-ionizing and cannot generate biological viruses.
relevant_passages: Radio waves from 5G networks cannot produce or transmit biological pathogens such as viruses.|Scientists and telecommunications authorities confirmed 5G uses non-ionizing frequency bands incapable of damaging DNA or creating viruses.
irrelevant_passages: The fifth generation of mobile technology delivers higher data bandwidth and lower transmission latency.|Cellular phone towers operate within spectrum bands regulated by national communications agencies.

claim_text: Bill Gates announced plans to microchip the global population through vaccine programs.
supporting_summary: The claim originated from a distorted interpretation of an answer Gates gave during a Reddit AMA about digital certificates for health records. There are no microchips in vaccines.
relevant_passages: Fact-checkers and public health authorities confirmed vaccines do not contain microchips or tracking hardware.|Bill Gates and the Gates Foundation confirmed the proposal referred to encrypted digital health records not physical chips.
irrelevant_passages: Microsoft Corporation was founded in Albuquerque New Mexico by Bill Gates and Paul Allen in 1975.|The Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation funds global health initiatives combating malaria and polio.

claim_text: Pope Francis endorsed Donald Trump for president in 2016.
supporting_summary: The story originated on a satirical website WTOE 5 News and went viral. The Vatican maintains strict neutrality and never endorses political candidates.
relevant_passages: The Vatican confirmed Pope Francis did not endorse Donald Trump or any candidate in the US presidential election.|The story was originally fabricated by a self-described satirical website before circulating widely as fake news.
irrelevant_passages: Vatican City is an independent city-state enclaved within Rome Italy governed by the Bishop of Rome.|Papal encyclicals address matters of Catholic doctrine morals and contemporary global welfare.

claim_text: James Webb Space Telescope discovered an atmosphere containing carbon dioxide on exoplanet WASP-39 b.
supporting_summary: NASA's James Webb Space Telescope provided the first clear, detailed evidence for carbon dioxide in the atmosphere of a gas giant exoplanet orbiting a Sun-like star 700 light-years away.
relevant_passages: NASA confirmed Webb telescope detected clear molecular signatures of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere of exoplanet WASP-39 b.|Spectroscopic data from Webb NIRSpec instrument provided undisputed proof of carbon dioxide outside our solar system.
irrelevant_passages: Jupiter is the largest planet in our solar system with a prominent Great Red Spot storm.|Galileo Galilei observed the four largest moons of Jupiter using an early optical telescope in 1610.

claim_text: UNESCO declared the Indian National Anthem as the best national anthem in the world.
supporting_summary: UNESCO confirmed it never declared or ranked any country's national anthem as the best in the world. This is a recurring viral hoax circulating via messaging apps since 2008.
relevant_passages: UNESCO explicitly clarified that it does not evaluate rank or declare any national anthem as best.|The rumor has circulated repeatedly on social platforms since 2008 without any official UNESCO statement or record.
irrelevant_passages: The Indian national anthem Jana Gana Mana was originally composed in Bengali by Nobel laureate Rabindranath Tagore.|UNESCO is a specialized agency of the United Nations dedicated to world heritage and education.

claim_text: Sweden officially became the 32nd member of NATO in March 2024.
supporting_summary: Sweden formally joined the North Atlantic Treaty Organization on March 7, 2024, depositing its instrument of accession in Washington D.C. as the 32nd allied member.
relevant_passages: NATO Secretary General welcomed Sweden as the alliance's thirty-second member country on March 7 2024.|Swedish accession documents were formally deposited with the United States government in Washington.
irrelevant_passages: Stockholm is the capital city of Sweden situated across fourteen islands on the eastern coast.|The Nobel Prizes are awarded annually in Sweden and Norway according to the will of Alfred Nobel.

claim_text: Drinking bleach or disinfectant kills the coronavirus inside the human body.
supporting_summary: The FDA, CDC, and medical associations issued urgent warnings that drinking or injecting bleach or disinfectants causes severe poisoning, internal chemical burns, and death.
relevant_passages: The US FDA issued warnings that ingesting bleach or disinfectants causes chemical burns poisoning and possible death.|Public health agencies emphasize disinfectants are toxic chemicals intended solely for surface sanitation.
irrelevant_passages: Sodium hypochlorite is an inorganic chemical compound commonly used as a household laundry bleaching agent.|Handwashing with regular soap and water remains a standard hygiene practice to remove pathogens.
